subject: Re: Budget-range validation and next steps (Helix Payments)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@helix.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, May 10, 2026 at 3:02 PM PDT
Subject: Budget-range validation + next steps (Helix Payments)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can validate budget and procurement requirements on our side before we put a pilot together.

Recap from the call:
- Use case: conversational payments assistant for merchant support + transaction summaries.
- Expected traffic: mix of interactive sessions and automated summaries.
- Key success metrics: average latency <600ms for 95th pct, per-session quality, and cost per 1M tokens target <$30.

A few items we need to confirm (helps us model monthly spend and procurement):
1) Ballpark monthly token volume (low / mid / high scenario). If you can give ranges that’s perfect — e.g., 20M / 50M / 200M tokens per month.
2) Target unit economics — are you targeting <$30 / 1M tokens, <$20, or < $10 with committed pricing?
3) Procurement thresholds — does finance require PO/contract for monthly spend above a certain band or for annual commitments above a threshold? Any vendor onboarding steps we should expect?

I attached a short pricing snapshot (redwood-pricing-0426.pdf) that maps list and committed tiers; below is a quick mapping we typically use to make the math easy. These are illustrative — we can tailor with a Committed tier if you want multi-month pricing.

Illustrative unit costs (hosted models):
- Standard model (gen-std): list $20 / 1M tokens; committed 12mo $12 / 1M
- Large/fine-tuned model (gen-xl-ft): list $45 / 1M; committed 12mo $30 / 1M

Example monthly spend bands (list pricing):
- 20M tokens => ~$400 / month (list)
- 50M tokens => ~$1,000 / month (list)
- 200M tokens => ~$4,000 / month (list)

Procurement guidance: for customers in your size we typically:
- Support credit-card / self-serve for initial pilot up to ~$5k/mo.
- For >$5k/mo or annual commitments, finance prefers net-30 invoicing + PO.
- For multi-year / >$25k annual contracts, legal & SOW are standard (we have a template SOW attached).

Next steps: can you reply with the three items above (volume ranges, target $/1M, procurement thresholds)? Once we have that Aditya will put together a pilot proposal with committed pricing options and timeline.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, GTM Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-pricing-0426.pdf, SOW-template.docx
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@helix.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, May 11, 2026 at 9:15 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Budget-range validation + next steps (Helix Payments)

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Some rough numbers from our side after validating with product and finance:
- Traffic scenarios (monthly tokens): Low: ~20M, Mid: ~50–75M, High: ~250M (peak holiday).
- Target price: we’re hoping to keep unit costs under $30 / 1M tokens for standard quality models; if we can get committed pricing closer to $10–15 / 1M that becomes very attractive.
- Procurement: finance requires vendor onboarding when annual spend > $30k (so anything that pushes us >$30k/year needs a PO & vendor forms). For monthly invoices over $5k we need a PO and net-30 terms.

Two quick asks: 1) can you confirm billing cadence options (monthly invoice vs annual prepay) and whether we can start pilot on a credit card or do we need PO from day one? 2) Any limitations on test data (we will send masked transaction samples) and SOC2 support?

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min follow-up if helpful.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Payments Product
Helix Payments, Inc.
alex.j@helix.com | +1 (212) 555-1244
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@helix.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, May 12, 2026 at 10:07 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Budget-range validation + next steps (Helix Payments)

Thanks for the detail, Alex — super helpful. A few clarifications and how we’d translate this into a pilot + procurement-friendly path.

Billing & pilot options:
- Pilot: we can start on a credit card for an initial pilot up to $5k total spend. That removes friction and lets you validate latency/quality.
- If you want invoicing from day one, we can accept a PO for monthly invoices; standard net-30.
- Annual prepay / committed discounts: we can provide tiered discounts (example below) if you commit to a 6–12 month volume band.

Committed discount examples (illustrative):
- 50M/mo band committed: $10 / 1M tokens (effective $500 / month for 50M)
- 200M/mo band committed: $8 / 1M tokens (effective $1,600 / month for 200M)

Mapping to your scenarios (using list and committed examples):
- Low (20M): list ~$400/mo; committed ~$240/mo
- Mid (50–75M): list ~$1,000–$1,500/mo; committed ~$500–$750/mo
- High (250M): list ~$5,000/mo; committed ~$2,000/mo

Procurement implications: based on the thresholds you mentioned, the likely path is:
1) Start pilot on credit card (20–50M token cap) to validate performance.
2) If you hit >$5k/mo or want to move to sustained usage, finance will request a PO for monthly invoices (net-30).
3) Anything >$30k/year we’ll need to go through vendor onboarding + SOW/legal review (we can use the attached SOW-template and our standard DPA/SOC2 artifacts).

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm pilot target (suggest: 20–50M tokens for 4–6 weeks).
- I’ll have Aditya draft a pilot proposal with the committed band options and the SOW for procurement.
- Neha can run a quick technical review of integration and SOC2 needs (Neha: can you outline the onboarding docs we’ll share?).

If that sounds good I’ll send the pilot proposal and an estimated timeline.

Best,
Marissa
Director, GTM Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@helix.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, May 13, 2026 at 11:12 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Budget-range validation + next steps (Helix Payments)

Marissa / team —

Looks good. We’d like to start with a 4-week pilot capped at 25M tokens (credit card onboarding) to validate latency and prompt tuning. If pilot results are positive, procurement will aim for a 12-month committed band in the 50–75M monthly range (finance expects to budget $6k–$9k / month for platform spend which aligns with your committed examples).

I confirm procurement thresholds on our side: PO required for monthly invoices > $5k; vendor onboarding for annual > $30k. We’ll share masked sample data for the technical review.

Please send the pilot proposal and SOW and we’ll sign off on the PO process if we move to invoiced billing.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — let’s plan to have the pilot proposal in the next 48 hours.

Thanks,
Alex
